tasks.short: Observe teaching staff and recommend skill changes

steps.what: Observe the teaching staff during the lesson.
Write what the teaching showed in a note.
Evaluate performance against the chosen teaching skill.
Recommend changes that strengthen those teaching skills.

tasks.design: She watches the teaching in the room, writes what she saw, evaluates the skill and recommends the change to the teacher. No system drafts the recommendation, and nothing is filed as a staff record. The note stays her working note in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Judging a live lesson needed her in the room, and a form could not see the teaching.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the visit. A draft of a recommendation would still need the same observation.
tasks.still_hard: Two teachers can show the same skill differently, and only she can say which change fits this class.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the room, the pupils' response and the teacher's choice in the moment.
tasks.altitude: Her week of lesson visits is unchanged. She still watches, writes the note, evaluates the skill and recommends the change.

reach.task: Keep the lesson open to be observed and share the lesson plan
reach.learn: Which skill she will watch for before the visit.

evidence.claim: Watching a lesson and judging which teaching skill to change is not something a form can do. She has to be in the room.
Emotion recognition in education is banned, so this visit is not filmed and no emotion is read from the room.
A tool that monitors teaching staff needs staff consent, so she keeps a working note and does not add a monitoring record.

assumptions: The teacher keeps the lesson open and brings the lesson plan. She does not film the room.
The note is her working note in {DOCS}. It is not a staff-monitoring record, and it is not sent anywhere.
No tool is added, so incremental hours are zero.
The setting is a European school. The visit is still in the room.
unknowns: Whether this school already treats a lesson note as a formal performance record that would need staff consent.
research_questions: How often a recommended change is about the room or the materials rather than a teaching skill?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep on this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week of lesson visits. She still watches, writes the note, evaluates the skill and recommends the change herself, so nothing is shorter.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and conduct teacher training programs

steps.what: Name the classroom procedures and the teaching aids.
Draft the plan for these teacher training programs.

loop.input: The classroom procedures, teaching aids and session aim she wrote on the choice card in s1.
loop.output: Training-plan lines that quote only those procedures and aids, and say what the teachers will practise.
loop.check: Each line names a procedure or a teaching aid she wrote, and the sentence says what the teachers will practise with it. A line that adds a procedure, an aid or a practise she did not name fails.
loop.stop: One pass. A failing line is dropped and is not rewritten. If every line fails, the card stays blank and she writes the plan.
loop.why_not_simpler: A field copy of the procedure list cannot write the practise sentence that belongs with this procedure in this session.

steps.what: Check the plan quotes only procedures and aids she named.
File the confirmed training plan on the learning system.
Conduct the teacher training programs in the room.
Conduct the conference on instructional materials and equipment.

tasks.design: She names the classroom procedures and the teaching aids. A loop drafts the training plan by quoting only those names onto an internal card, she checks every line, and a separate step files the confirmed plan on the {LMS}. She still conducts the training and the conference in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: The training plan was rewritten by hand from last year's pack each time a procedure changed.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can quote only the procedures and aids she has already written, and drop a line that adds one.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing which aid belongs in this school, and teaching the session, stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which procedure the teachers will actually use on Monday.

ambition.what: Each time a classroom procedure changes, she refreshes that training plan instead of carrying last year's pack into the room.

tasks.altitude: She still names the procedures and still runs both sessions. The week loses the first draft of the plan and the filing of that plan.

reach.learn: Which procedure names the plan is allowed to quote.

evidence.claim: Easygenerator drafts a course from an existing document. This design drafts only a training plan from procedure names she wrote, and she checks every line before it is filed.
A documented trial of a lesson-drafting assistant found quality no worse. This range does not use that trial's time figures, and the trial was lesson preparation rather than this training week.
Annex III high-risk education uses are admission, evaluating learning outcomes, assessing level and proctoring. Drafting a staff training plan is not on that list.
Running the training session and the conference stays with the person. The digest notes that training stays human, and no source there measures a shorter session.

assumptions: She writes the classroom procedure names, the teaching aids and the session aim on a choice card before the draft runs. If she names none, the draft does not run and the file step does not run.

The programme lead keeps those procedure names current. An equipment owner keeps the list of teaching aids in the room, and she copies the ones she will use onto the card. No equipment is ordered from this task.
The file step writes only the confirmed plan to {LMS}. It does not invite anyone and it does not message the teachers.
Six hours per 100 baseline hours is the check that each line quotes a procedure or aid she named. Two further hours is removing a line that quoted a retired procedure, beyond that check.
The range does not use a vendor speed claim or a lesson-preparation trial's minutes.
unknowns: Whether the learning system accepts a training plan from this role without a second sign-off.
research_questions: How often a procedure name changes between two sessions of the same programme?

already_counted.description: Checking that each plan line quotes a procedure or aid she named.

incremental.description: Removing a plan line that quoted a retired procedure, outside the check on that run.

approvals.approved_version: The confirmed training plan from s3, bound to the classroom procedures and teaching aids she named in s1. A change to those names voids this approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week she still runs the training and the conference in the room. Only the plan draft and the file of that plan are shorter. A week with a procedure she has not named yet saves nothing on the draft. Two hours per 100 baseline hours is removing a retired line, beyond the check. High stays under the net of 18.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret and enforce education codes and rules

steps.what: Name which education codes and board rules apply.
Fetch the named provision from the education codes.
Interpret that education code for this pupil case.
Enforce the education rule with the people present.
Write the enforcement note in the school file.

tasks.design: She names the education codes and the board rules that apply. A lookup copies that named provision from the school copy in {DOCS} onto a working card, and she interprets the case, enforces the rule with the people present, and writes the note herself. The card stays empty when the article is missing, and the pupil case is not placed in the lookup.
tasks.previous_blocker: The code is long prose, and a checklist could not say whether this pupil case was a breach.
tasks.enabler_now: The in-force text can be stored by article number, so she opens the provision she named instead of hunting the volume.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the facts meet the rule, and what to say to the people present, is her judgement.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the case and decides the response. The lookup only shows the sentence.
tasks.altitude: She still interprets the case and still enforces the rule in person. The week loses only the hunt for a provision whose article number she already named.

reach.task: Store the in-force education code by article in the document store
reach.learn: Which article numbers she may ask the lookup to fetch.

evidence.claim: National education rules are prose. A lookup of an article she named cannot decide whether this case is a breach.
Under 16, consent comes from the legal representative, and personal data does not go into an AI tool. The pupil case stays in the note she writes.

assumptions: She writes the article number on a card before the lookup. The clerk stores the in-force national education code in {DOCS}. The education authority published that text. If the number misses, the card stays empty and she reads the volume during the interpret step.
The lookup copies the named provision onto a working card. It does not decide a breach, it does not set a sanction, and it does not notify anyone.
The pupil case and any name stay in the note she writes. They are not put in the lookup.
Four hours per 100 baseline hours is reading the fetched provision inside the interpret step. One further hour is hunting a second copy when the card is empty, beyond that interpret.
The setting is a European school using national rules and the board's own regulations.
unknowns: Whether the school copy of the code is already split by article number.
research_questions: How often the article she names is missing from the stored text?

already_counted.description: Reading the fetched provision before she decides what the rule means for this case.

incremental.description: Hunting a second copy when the article card is empty, beyond the interpret on that case.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week the stored article is already under the number she named. When the text is missing she reads the code herself and the lookup saves nothing. One hour per 100 baseline hours is that hunt, beyond the interpret. High stays under the net of 7.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Name the intellectual, social and physical welfare topics.
Draft the workshop agenda from those welfare topics.

loop.input: The intellectual, social and physical welfare topics she wrote, and the meeting purpose.
loop.output: Agenda lines that quote only those topics and say what the meeting will discuss.
loop.check: Each line quotes a welfare topic she wrote and says what the meeting will discuss about it. A line that adds a topic or names a student fails.
loop.stop: One pass. A failing line is dropped and is not rewritten. If every line fails, the card stays blank and she writes the agenda.
loop.why_not_simpler: A copy of the topic list does not say what this meeting will discuss.

steps.what: Check each agenda line quotes a topic she named.
Conduct the workshops that promote students welfare.
Participate in the committees for students welfare.
Participate in the conferences for students welfare.

tasks.design: She names the intellectual, social and physical welfare topics. A loop drafts an agenda card that quotes only those topics, and she checks every line. She still conducts the workshops and takes part in the committees and conferences. The card is not filed and not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each workshop agenda was typed again from a rough list of welfare topics.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can turn the topics she named into agenda lines and drop a line that adds a topic or a student.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation in the workshop, the committee and the conference is the work.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what the students and colleagues actually raise.
tasks.altitude: She still conducts the workshops and still sits in the committees and conferences. The week loses only the first draft of an agenda from topics she named.

reach.task: Set the purpose of the committee before the agenda is drafted
reach.learn: Which welfare topics are in scope this term.

evidence.claim: An agenda card does not shorten the workshop, the committee or the conference. Those meetings stay with the people in the room.
Under 16, consent comes from the legal representative, and personal data does not go into an AI tool. The agenda card does not name a student.
Emotion recognition in education is banned, so the workshop is not filmed and no emotion is read from the room.

assumptions: She writes the welfare topics before the agenda draft. The student-welfare lead sets the committee purpose. If she names no topic, the draft does not run.
The agenda card quotes topics only. It does not name a student, it is not filed as a record, and it is not sent.
Four hours per 100 baseline hours is the check that each line quotes a topic she named. One further hour is striking a line that named a student, beyond that check.
The workshops, committees and conferences stay in the room.
unknowns: Whether committee chairs already publish a written purpose before she drafts an agenda.
research_questions: How often an agenda line would have named a student under today's practice?

already_counted.description: Checking that each agenda line quotes a welfare topic she named and does not name a student.

incremental.description: Striking an agenda line that named a student, beyond the check on that meeting.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week the agenda is only a card of topics she already named. The workshops, committees and conferences still take the full meeting. When she has not named the topics, the draft saves nothing. One hour per 100 baseline hours is striking a line that named a student, beyond the check. High stays under the net of 7.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still observing lessons, running training, enforcing education rules and sitting in welfare meetings. She still watches the lesson, sets every recommendation, conducts the sessions, interprets the rule and attends. Only the training-plan draft, its file on the learning system, the article card and the agenda card move.
reach: The teacher keeps the lesson open to be observed and supplies the lesson plan.
The programme lead keeps classroom procedure names stable enough for the training plan to quote.
The clerk stores the in-force education code by article in the document store.
The student-welfare lead sets the committee purpose before an agenda is drafted.
skills_to_grow: Reject a training-plan line that adds a procedure or an aid she did not name.
Read the education article herself when the stored text is missing.
Keep a pupil name off the agenda card and out of the lookup.
Watch the lesson and recommend the change without a camera or a monitoring record.
role.ambitious_version: When a classroom procedure changes, she confirms a fresh training plan before the session, and the lesson visit, the conference, the rule and the welfare meeting stay hers.
